edges.reason: unlock compares _previousOwner with msg.sender to authorize ownership restoration.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sending address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance deduction.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
constructor assigns the entire reflection supply to msg.sender.
_transfer is fed from = _msgSender() when called from transfer.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the router swap deadline.
addLiquidity passes block.timestamp as the router liquidity deadline.
lock sets _lockTime using now plus the provided duration.
unlock requires now to exceed the stored _lockTime.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
_transfer can trigger swapAndLiquify which performs external ETH transfers.
_transfer finalizes with _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard for non-excluded pairs.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to process fees.
_transferStandard calls _takeLiquidity to accumulate liquidity tokens.
_transferStandard calls _getValues to compute reflection values.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external router swap.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity which performs an external router call.
swapAndLiquify transfers ETH to the wallet address, handing control to an external party.
swapAndLiquify transfers ETH to the rewards wallet, handing control to an external party.
swapTokensForEth invokes the router swap entry point.
addLiquidity invokes the router addLiquidityETH entry point.
wallet address is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
rewardsWallet address is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
pancakeRouter is the target of the token to ETH swap.
pancakeRouter is the target of the addLiquidityETH call.
inSwapAndLiquify guard is checked before swapAndLiquify executes external calls.
unlock restores _owner from the stored _previousOwner.
unlock verifies _previousOwner matches the caller.
unlock compares the current timestamp against _lockTime.
lock moves the current _owner into _previousOwner.
lock writes the new unlock timestamp into _lockTime.
changeLimit flips the limit flag that constrains transfers.
setTaxFeePercent writes the new _taxFee value.
setLiquidityFeePercent writes the new _liquidityFee value.
_transfer enforces the _maxTxAmount limit on non-exempt transfers.
setMaxTxPercent derives _maxTxAmount from _tTotal.
setPair writes the pancakePair address.
setRouter writes the pancakeRouter address.
constructor mints the full _rTotal reflection supply to the deployer.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates the automatic swap and liquify execution.
deliver subtracts the computed reflection amount from _rOwned.
_transfer increments numberOfTokenHolders when a new holder appears.
_transfer consults the exist mapping before registering a holder.
amount parameter drives limits and balances inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance local determines whether the swap threshold is met.
takeFee local is forwarded to _tokenTransfer to decide fee removal.
tAmount parameter is consumed by _transferStandard value computations.
_sender parameter is used to look up the holder balance in expectedRewards.
time parameter is added to now to set _lockTime.
currentRate local stores the result returned by _getRate.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only exists as an input of _transfer and should be absorbed into its core function node.
The local contractTokenBalance is used solely to compute the swap threshold inside _transfer.
The takeFee local is passed directly into _tokenTransfer to control fee removal and can be merged there.
The tAmount parameter is the sole numeric input of _transferStandard and merges into it.
The _sender parameter is only used for balance lookups inside the expectedRewards view function.
The time parameter is only consumed to derive the lock timestamp inside lock.
The currentRate local simply holds the division result computed in _getRate.
